description: Full-featured interactive Gantt chart for project scheduling. Combines a tree grid of tasks with a zoomable timeline and a toolbar for adding tasks, expand/collapse, day/week/month views, and cascade sort. Supports task hierarchies and dependencies, baselines, time tracking, bulk edits, filtering, import/export, critical-path and overdue highlighting, a workload panel, resource calendars, and optional real-time SignalR updates.

parameters.name: ToolbarLabels
parameters.description: How the toolbar buttons show their text. The default Icons keeps the icon-only row (the text stays the accessible name and the tooltip); IconsWithText shows every label; Auto shows them except on a toolbar narrower than 640px. Maps onto TmToolbar.Labels.

parameters.name: ShowQuickSearch
parameters.description: When true, the toolbar ends with a "Search tasks…" box that writes a Title/Contains entry into Filters (raising OnFiltersChanged); emptying the box removes it.

parameters.name: FilterPanelMode
parameters.description: How the filter editor is presented: Inline (default) is a strip under the toolbar, Dialog a modal dialog (a bottom sheet on a mobile viewport) whose footer is Clear all | Cancel | Apply, and Auto picks by the Gantt's own container (a dialog on a tablet or narrower container, the inline strip on a desktop one). Active filters also show as removable chips under the toolbar.

parameters.name: SidebarMode
parameters.description: How the Tasks / Workload / History / Notifications / Reports panels are offered: the vertical icon Rail (default) or a horizontal Tabs strip with text labels (ARIA tabs). ShowSidebar = false hides either.

parameters.name: HeaderStart
parameters.description: Host content at the start of the header row, after the Title (a project switcher, a breadcrumb).

parameters.name: HeaderActions
parameters.description: Host actions at the end of the header row (Share, Save…). The Gantt has no built-in header actions.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Header title text. The header renders only when at least one of Title, Subtitle, HeaderStart or HeaderActions is set.

parameters.name: Subtitle
parameters.description: Secondary header line under the Title.

parameters.name: ShowHeader
parameters.description: Set false to hide the header row even when its slots are filled. With no slot set there is no header (today's look).

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description: In-memory work items. Used when WorkItemSource is null.

parameters.name: DependencyItems
parameters.description: In-memory dependencies. Used when WorkItemSource is null.

parameters.name: WorkItemSource
parameters.description: Unified work-item source shared with other components. When set, the chart loads its items and dependencies from this provider instead of Items/DependencyItems, and routes task mutations back through it (when the provider declares the matching capability).

parameters.name: ShowTaskPanel
parameters.description: Whether the task panel is shown. The Gantt never assigns this parameter: internal changes update the internal open state and raise ShowTaskPanelChanged (two-way), and a changed incoming value re-seeds it.

parameters.name: ShowTaskPanelChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the task panel's open state changes through an internal path (open on selection, toolbar toggle, sheet close). Pair with ShowTaskPanel for two-way binding.

parameters.name: ActiveBaselineId
parameters.description: ID of the currently active baseline to compare against.

parameters.name: ActiveTimerTaskId
parameters.description: Task ID of the currently running stopwatch timer. Null = no active timer.

parameters.name: AllowBulkSelect
parameters.description: When true, each tree row shows a checkbox for bulk selection.

parameters.name: AllowDependencyCreation
parameters.description: When true, dep-drag handles are rendered on every task bar.

parameters.name: AutoSchedule
parameters.description: When true, auto-schedules tasks based on dependencies when parameters are set.

parameters.name: Baselines
parameters.description: Named schedule snapshots for baseline comparison.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes appended to the root element.

parameters.name: Columns
parameters.description: Column definitions for the tree grid. Defaults to all standard columns visible.

parameters.name: CustomFields
parameters.description: User-defined custom field definitions.

parameters.name: Filters
parameters.description: Active filter set. Empty = show all tasks.

parameters.name: History
parameters.description: Activity history entries to display in the history drawer.

parameters.name: NotificationSettings
parameters.description: Notification preferences for the current user.

parameters.name: OnAutoScheduled
parameters.description: Fires after auto-scheduling with the updated task list.

parameters.name: OnBaselineSaved
parameters.description: Fires after a new baseline is saved.

parameters.name: OnBulkUpdate
parameters.description: Fires when the user triggers a bulk status/property update.

parameters.name: OnColumnsChanged
parameters.description: Fires when column visibility/order changes via the column toggle UI.

parameters.name: OnCustomFieldChanged
parameters.type: EventCallback<(string TaskId, string FieldId, string? Value)>
parameters.description: Fires when a custom field value is committed for a task. Args: (taskId, fieldId, value).

parameters.name: OnDataSorted
parameters.description: Fires when the data order changes via cascade sort.

parameters.name: OnDependencyAdded
parameters.description: Fires when the task is saved with valid data.

parameters.name: OnDependencyRemoved
parameters.description: Fires when a new dependency is added.

parameters.name: OnExportRequested
parameters.description: Fires when the user requests an export (contains selected options).

parameters.name: OnFiltersChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the user adds/removes filters via the filter panel.

parameters.name: OnImportCompleted
parameters.description: Fires when an import operation completes successfully.

parameters.name: OnImportResultCompleted
parameters.description: Fires when a result-capable import completes with the full payload — tasks, dependencies and warnings. Raised in addition to OnImportCompleted (which keeps carrying only the tasks), after every new dependency has also been announced through OnDependencyAdded.

parameters.name: OnImportError
parameters.description: Fires when an import operation fails (contains error message).

parameters.name: OnNotificationTriggered
parameters.description: Fires when a notification condition is met (assign, mention, deadline).

parameters.name: OnReportRun
parameters.description: Fires when the user clicks "Run" on a report.

parameters.name: OnResourceCalendarChanged
parameters.description: Fires when a resource calendar entry changes.

parameters.name: OnRollbackRequested
parameters.description: Fires when the user requests rollback to the state before a history entry.

parameters.name: OnStatusChanged
parameters.description: Fires when a task's status is changed from the board view.

parameters.name: OnTaskUpdated
parameters.description: Existing dependencies.

parameters.name: OnTimerStarted
parameters.description: Fires when the user starts the stopwatch for a task.

parameters.name: OnTimerStopped
parameters.description: Fires when the user stops the stopwatch for a task, providing the completed log entry.

parameters.name: OnTimeTravelRequested
parameters.description: Audit-log entries to display in the history drawer.

parameters.name: OnViewSettingsChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the user changes a view setting via the built-in dropdown.

parameters.name: OnVirtualResourceAdded
parameters.description: Fires when the user creates a new virtual (placeholder) resource.

parameters.name: RealtimeConnection
parameters.description: Optional real-time SignalR connection for live task updates.

parameters.name: Reports
parameters.description: Report definitions shown in the Reports sidebar panel.

parameters.name: ResourceCalendars
parameters.description: Resource calendars for vacation/day-off overlays in People view.

parameters.name: ShowCriticalPath
parameters.description: When true, highlights critical-path tasks with a distinct bar color.

parameters.name: ShowOverdueHighlight
parameters.description: When true, overdue tasks (End in past, not done) are highlighted.

parameters.name: ShowSidebar
parameters.description: When true (default), the left sidebar navigation is visible.

parameters.name: ShowWorkloadPanel
parameters.description: Computes the workload overload that drives the warning icons next to a task's assignees (nothing is drawn by this flag itself; the docked panel is switched on with WorkloadPlacement). Unchanged.

parameters.name: ViewSettings
parameters.description: View display settings (today marker, days off, density, theme…).

parameters.name: WorkingSchedule
parameters.description: Working schedule used to shade non-working days/hours in the timeline.

parameters.name: WorkloadDisplayMode
parameters.description: Whether workload is displayed in hours or as a percentage of capacity.

parameters.name: ZoomPreset
parameters.description: Current timeline zoom preset (Weeks by default).

parameters.name: ContainerWidth
parameters.description: Obsolete: use LayoutMode. Width in pixels the Fit to screen action fits the timeline into. When null (default) the timeline element is measured in the browser. While LayoutMode is Auto, a width set here is also classified into a layout (below 640 mobile, below 1024 tablet, otherwise desktop).

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the Gantt renders. Auto (default) measures the Gantt's own container (desktop from 1024 px, tablet from 640 px, otherwise mobile); a forced value, or a forced cascading TmLayoutContext ancestor, pins it. Tablet renders a two-row toolbar with a More overflow, a narrower task tree and finger-sized targets; the layout is stamped as data-layout on the root.

parameters.name: ResolvedLayoutChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the resolved layout changes (never for the initial value). Do not pair it with LayoutMode.

parameters.name: TaskBreadcrumb
parameters.description: Optional breadcrumb (a host-drawn project / parent path) for the task detail: the task panel header and the mobile task sheet render it above the task title. Null renders nothing.

parameters.name: TaskPanelMode
parameters.description: How the task panel and the Reports inspector are presented: Inline (default) is the in-flow column at every width, Overlay a TmSidePanel side sheet with the tabs Detail | Attachments | Comments | History, Auto the in-flow panel on a desktop container and the side sheet on a tablet or narrower one. On a narrow container at most one right-hand surface (task panel, reports, history) is open.

parameters.name: OnNewReportRequested
parameters.description: Fires when the user asks for a new report from the Reports panel. The "New report" button is only rendered when the host handles this callback.

parameters.name: OnDescriptionChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the user edits the description of the selected task in the task panel (live).

parameters.name: OnAttachmentUpload
parameters.description: Fires when the user picks a file to attach to the selected task in the task panel. Persisting the file is the host's job.

parameters.name: OnAttachmentRemoved
parameters.description: Fires when the user removes an attachment of the selected task in the task panel (argument = attachment id).

parameters.name: WorkloadDisplayModeChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user flips the Hours | Percent segment of the docked workload panel (arg = the new mode; two-way with WorkloadDisplayMode).

parameters.name: WorkloadPlacement
parameters.description: Where the workload is shown. View (default) keeps the alternate Workload view; Docked adds a panel under the timeline that shares the Gantt's date range and scrolls horizontally with it. The panel renders whatever ShowWorkloadPanel says - that flag only switches on the overload computation behind the warning icons; its semantics are unchanged.

parameters.name: HistoryDrawerPlacement
parameters.description: What the history drawer is positioned against: Component (default) pins it to the right edge of this Gantt; Viewport restores the pre-redesign full-viewport-height panel.

parameters.name: ShowToolbar
parameters.description: When false the command toolbar is not rendered (a nested Gantt of the portfolio, a host that drives the chart through its own chrome). The panel tabs / sidebar are switched off separately by ShowSidebar.

parameters.name: OnReportEdit
parameters.description: Fires when the user picks Edit in a report card's menu. The menu item (and the menu) exist only when this is handled.

parameters.name: OnReportDelete
parameters.description: Fires when the user picks Delete in a report card's menu. The menu item (and the menu) exist only when this is handled.

parameters.name: OnReportDuplicate
parameters.description: Fires when the user picks Duplicate in a report card's menu. The menu item (and the menu) exist only when this is handled.
